channel.title: The Nanny
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Nanny" - A mysterious creature who 'cares' for its victims

item.title: Re: The Nanny
item.content:encoded:
Hey! Appreciate the DM reminder. Apologies for making you wait. I get wrapped up in other things and forget to check back in ‘round here.

Okay, so, you have a decent set-up here. It’s a little 2011 but there’s nothing wrong with that. But I do think what you have is only a basic starter for a robust SCP article and it’s pretty close to SCP-610.

I want to know more about these characters. I need you to bring them to life for me because what you have here are cardboard cut-outs. You have a decent creepy idea but you need to a) flesh it out into a full-fledged story, and b) differentiate it from SCP-610 a little more. And I think the characters are where you can accomplish that.

I can’t give you a greenlight but I want you to marinate on the world you’re creating until someone else else does. Your big hurdle here is figuring out the story you want to tell with the framework you’ve created. Don’t be afraid to reach out to an experienced author if your idea goes another few days without further comment.

Godspeed, homie. ✌️

item.title: Re: The Nanny
item.content:encoded: I was thinking that it was a normal human nanny invited into a household to care for the family. However, the family were Sarkites and they performed a ritual to 'ascend' themselves and members of the household. The family had built an extensive set of tunnels beneath their house and when they performed the ritual they were put into pods undergoing a metamorphosis to become powerful entities. The rest of the staff of the house were transformed into horrifying entities all with different tasks, the nanny brings people to the pods, the cook prepares them for consumption by the family, the gardener maintains the tunnels in which they spawn their creatures and the butler feeds them by performing a ritual. I was also thinking that perhaps they have smaller entities called busyboys or handmaids which perform basic grunt work like tunnel digging as well as defence. The only 'non-monstrous' entity is the butler who through communication implies that perhaps he turned the family to sarkicism.

item.title: Re: The Nanny
item.content:encoded:
Reads like a generic monster to me. You’ll need something more than this to be successful. What you have is a basic broth. You need some meat, vegetables, and spices before you have a full-fledged SCP article.

Do you have any ideas for narrative beyond what the entity does? Who it was? Where it came from? How it affected the lives of people living not too far away?

You’re seriously lacking in story here.

item.title: Creature that thinks it's a nanny
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Elevator Pitch:

  • An entity that refers to itself as the Nanny.
  • capable of producing a thick fog around it. Lives in a marshland in the south of England.
  • It tries to lure people towards it with glowing globules of light. Once a person reaches it, it will proceed to ask them to tea, to play some games or have their medicine (other things as well). Keeps the person captive performing perversions of nanny-care. For example, feeding someone their medicine might be pushing mud into their mouth or giving them tea might be feeding them mud and rocks. It essentially tries to immobilise them under the ruse of caring for them.
  • Once they have been deemed to have sufficiently cared for, the nanny takes them to a place it refers to as 'the garden' (is a recession in the ground with various pods and bulbs hanging on the walls) there it introduces them to the 'other children' which appear to be larvae or younglings of this creature who then devour the human.

Central Narrative: D-class sent into the marsh, discover the nanny and are brought to the garden, try escaping. Reveals other ability of the SCP, has full control over the location, temperature and density of the fog around it. Used to help catch prey or defend itself.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: An entity that lures people with lights sort of like an angler fish, also similar to will'o'wisps which could explain the folklore in that area.

Additional Notes: NONE
